checks.name: rain leaves puddles with rings on the tracks, splashes around the raccoon and rings on the creek; none on a clear day
the jellyfish glows through the sea at night
the fox den: the fox sleeps in front by day, peeks out at dusk, only its eyes show at night; F at the trail finds it
the heart stone shows its heart only face on; that photo finds it, the trail view does not
the carving sits on the lookout timber behind the view; a photo of it finds it
spring fills the meadow with flowers, autumn lays leaves; summer nights have the most fireflies
the field guide lists six hidden corners, the three new ones found
